Mia (CS): heads-up — AcmeCorp onboarding hitting a weird pattern in staging: initial SDK handshake succeeds, then a flurry of 401s for ~30s, followed by 429s once they retry aggressively. Customer saying it started after they flipped on their internal edge-proxy. attaching logs.
Joe (Eng): thanks — can you paste the SDK init snippet and the exact error payload from the 401s?
Mia (CS): snippet from their app: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, env: 'staging' })` — errors show `401 {"error":"invalid_token","detail":"token expired"}` then later `429 Too Many Requests` in quick succession. They use ephemeral tokens via a proxy that mints short-lived JWTs.
Ravi (Support): is the proxy reusing connections? Maybe multiple app instances stampede token refresh and then fanout preflight to our auth service.
Joe (Eng): possible. Do we have their client parallelism? If they warm 50 processes at once, and each preflight fetches a token, that can create a thundering herd against our token endpoint and cause rateback. Also if tokens are slightly out-of-sync (clock skew) you can see transient 401s.
Mia (CS): they said they start 20 worker pods in <1min during deploy. their clock skew looked okay (ntp), but the proxy logs show many token requests with identical client_id in parallel.
Joe (Eng): two likely levers: 1) make proxy cache tokens for a small TTL window and add jitter/splay on refresh, 2) client-side: add preflight coalescing or a single token-leasing thread per instance. We should share a short checklist for them.
Mia (CS): can you draft quick remediation steps I can send? Also they asked if we can temporarily raise rate limits for their staging org to avoid disruptions while they fix.
Ravi (Support): +1 on checklist. For rate limits — we can temporarily bump staging quotas if we confirm it's staging and short duration. I'll open a ticket with infra to scope that and log it.
Joe (Eng): draft checklist: 1) enable token-cache in proxy (cache token for 5s after mint), 2) add refresh jitter: random(0,500ms) before mint, 3) consolidate token requests per host process, 4) reduce preflight fanout: stagger startup by 2s, 5) if using ephemeral tokens, ensure token TTL >= expected startup jitter. Include a sample curl test to validate: `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health`
Mia (CS): perfect. I'll send that. For the temporary quota bump — Ravi, can you confirm requested window? They want a 2hr bump while they deploy the proxy change.
Ravi (Support): I'll request a 2hr staging bump to infra and note it in the ticket. tagging deploy-bot to record change.
deploy-bot: [automated] Created infra ticket INF-8341 for staging rate limit bump (2 hours) requested by Ravi (Support).
Joe (Eng): one more diagnostic idea: ask them to turn on request-id header capture and paste the first 401/429 pair so we can trace on our side. Also include the raw Authorization header (trim token) so we can check expiry claim.
Mia (CS): sending checklist + request-id instructions now. I'll follow up after they try proxy cache+stagger. If infra approves the bump we can keep watch.
Ravi (Support): noted — I'll update INF-8341 with the org id and expected window. thanks team :thumbsup:
Mia (CS): thanks all — quick win if proxy caches; I'll post results here when they test.
